{{Quote|What the heck kind of rescue was that?|Rat, to the Rebels who rescued him from the thugs of the Hutt crime lord Brinojja|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
'''Rat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] who operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rat met in a Nar Shaddaa [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents seeking information from regarding the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. However, their liaison was interrupted by thugs sent by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Brinojja]] to apprehend Rat and the information merchant was forced to flee Nar Shaddaa with the Rebels. Rat subsequently accompanied the Rebels to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an attack by the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Being sucked out of a perfectly good building, into a hover ship over a bottomless pit. That's a rescue?|Rat, to the Rebels who rescued him from the thugs of the Hutt crime lord Brinojja|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
[[File:Nar_Shaddaa_LoNH.png|thumb|left|200px|Nar Shaddaa, the world on which Rat operated]]
Rat was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who operated as [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> while passing through a busy Nar Shaddaa [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Rat witnessed the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] dock a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] at a private [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]]. Noting the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapon that Rystra carried on his belt, Rat's interest was piqued and he surreptitiously followed Rystra and the Dark Jedi's companion, the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Caeleb]]. Rat observed a gang accost Rystra and witnessed the Dark Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] thug among the group into [[Death/Legends|killing]] the other gang members before taking its own life. The information merchant followed Rystra and Caeleb to a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]], remaining unseen, and eavesdropped on a liaison between the Dark Jedi and and agent of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group, of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] world [[Pamorjal]]. After Rystra departed the bar, Rat waited thirty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] and returned to the landing bay where the Dark Jedi had arrived on Nar Shaddaa, noting Rystra's starship to no longer be present there.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Four [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents hunting Rystra made contact with Rat and the information broker agreed to meet with them at a Nar Shaddaa bar. Just as he sat down with the Rebels to conduct business, thugs of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Brinojja]] burst into the bar to apprehend Rat for their master. The information broker fled with the Rebels out of the back of the bar and through the streets of Nar Shaddaa, with the thugs and Brinojja's chief enforcer [[Verkoss]] in hot pursuit. Pinned down at a dead end, Rat and the Rebels were forced into a fierce [[lightfight]] with the thugs and were rescued by the Rebel [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Maric Tovar]], who airlifted the group to safety in the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. Rat subsequently accompanied the Rebels as the freighter departed Nar Shaddaa and jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Unnerved by his ordeal, Rat initially refused to leave the landing bay of the vessel until the Rebels helped him regain his composure. Once they had reached a safe distance from Nar Shaddaa, the freighter left hyperspace and Rat recommenced his negotiations with the Rebels. In return for sharing information on Rystra he demanded transit to [[Celanon City]] on the planet [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to use as startup funds to setup his business afresh. Rat regarded this offer a discount on his usual fee; though uncertain of the value of his information on Rystra, the information merchant proclaimed that he would ordinarily charge 10,000 credits for such intelligence. After reaching agreement with the Rebels on his fee, Rat recounted his sighting of Rystra on Nar Shaddaa and revealed details that he had overheard from Rystra's conversation with the PFL of the Dark Jedi's intention to travel to Pamorjal and that Rystra had warned the PFL to be wary of his Rebel pursuers' combat capability due to their killing of the Dark Jedi's apprentice [[Tol Skaros]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Much to Rat's displeasure,<ref name="Soulsaber" /> the Rebels proceeded to Pamorjal,<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> and docked in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Beldon (city)|Beldon]], seeking to catch-up with Rystra first prior to dropping Rat off on Celanon.<ref name="Soulsaber" /> In protest at the delay in his journey, Rat remained on board the ship<ref name="Death" /> while the Rebels left to look for clues regarding Rystra's location, refusing to disembark until he reached Celanon. However, misled by false claims from Rystra that the Rebels were agents of the corporation [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] seeking to exploit Pamorjal's natural resources, the PFL blew up the ''Lazy Katarn'' in a [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] attack<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and Rat was killed.<ref name="Death" /> Following the attack, the Rebels noted Rat to be missing and<ref name="Light and Dark" /> futily<ref name="Death" /> attempted to contact the information merchant.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|None of this was part of the deal.|Rat, berating the Rebels who rescued him on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
Rat was a fan of bootleg [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] and had watched many of them. He was an astute businessman and was willing to lie when conducting negotiations to further his aims. He was greatly rattled by his close encounter with Brinojja's thugs on Nar Shaddaa and feared for his life. Consequently, he was ineffectual in the battle, letting the Rebels take the lead in keeping his attackers at bay. In his flustered state he felt anger toward his Rebel rescuers for their role in the frightening experience, though once he cooled down he expressed his gratitude to them for saving him. He was capable of petulance and was vocal in his displeasure when the Rebels decided to travel to Pamorjal instead of transporting him directly to Celanon.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Equipment==
Rat was armed with a hold-out [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]. During his encounter with the Rebel agents who rescued him on Nar Shaddaa he wore street [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rat was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and appeared in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']], the second instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]], published by [[RPGA]] in [[2001]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> He was later mentioned in the concluding instalment of the ''Child of Light'' saga, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], in [[2002]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

In ''Soulsaber'', the players roleplay as the Rebel agents that Rat meets with on Nar Shaddaa. In his negotiations with the Rebels regarding his fee for sharing information on Thaum Rystra, Rat initially proposes that he be paid 1,500 credits but that he can be persuaded down to a price of 1,000 credits. Rat requests that, in return for his information, the Rebels ferry him to Celanon, and it is possible either that the players transport him directly to Celanon or instead to travel first to Pamorjal. If the players do agree to go first to Celanon, upon arrival Rat quickly disembarks in Celanon City and parts way with the Rebels. If the player characters instead opt to proceed directly to Pamorjal, Rat is vexed and remains on the ship when they reach Pamorjal, perishing when the vessel is blown up by the Pamorjal Freeman's League.<ref name="Soulsaber" /> ''Light and Dark'' confirms that the Rebels ventured directly to Pamorjal with Rat in their company,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> thus making the information merchant's death on Pamorjal the official outcome.<ref name="Death" />
